lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical and horizontal rows, forming a regular grid-like pattern posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of white spots, creating a lattice structure where spots act as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A visible horizontal ridge (carina) runs along the upper flank, showing a sharp transition from a high-luminance upper edge to a shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated, fusiform shape (likely a remora) is positioned on the mid-lateral flank, creating a high-contrast interruption in the spot pattern.
